notes.title: Build 0.8.0
notes.content:
Build 0.8.0 is out and the last story level 'Sewer' has been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/f4aa3535751111fe2886e1dce11323e40f6467ff.gif[/img]

In that world you'll encounter a new game mode, I like to call Math Blaster because it's inspired by the old DOS game where you have to shoot correct math problems in space. 
This mode is also available to play in the Extras menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/d8ad999654b84f6b07f0e7478d1bd57b3406e353.gif[/img]

Full notes:
[Added]
- Story world 4
- Math Blaster mode in Extras
- Inequality Shipment mode in Extras (featured in World 3)
- 2 Story related achievements
[Fixes]
- Fixed bomb and swap items not working correctly
- Fixed various UI issues navigating with a controller
- Various sprite cleanups

Whats Next:
- Story cutscenes, animation and general transition cleanups.
- Bring online mode to parity (items, co-op)
- More sprite cleanups and changes.

Thanks for playing!
ScienceRobot

notes.title: Build 0.7.0
notes.content:
Build 0.7.0 is out and adds some cool new classic mode features.  

[b]New Classic Level 'Lights Out'[/b]
[b]Classic Mode Co-op[/b]
[b]Classic Mode Items[/b]
[list]
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/ddaeddd0454a38e6509526bbda263783e88cb75f.png[/img]
Bomb - Remove all the current numbers on the level and spawn new ones
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/12c883b6696e286eefa2418ede569fc0a0e48dbb.png[/img]
Swap - Player 1 and Player 2 swap current calculations
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/4da124c1e6c3fb254f35c9fceafd752f84a7f148.png[/img]
Gravity - Change the gravity of the other player for 10 seconds
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/68efd148d20c4861b975a0f44180a917bb35d7c7.png[/img]
Calculate - Automatically solve the current number
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/5ff7a57b83fce090de3227efc15dd6a501cd80c6.png[/img]
Erase - Erase the other players current calculation
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/0a8df143671544309508d10a2d9f306f872a6ad9.png[/img]
Question - Create new target number
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/0d5fe407859f7df91daaf19fb9bf4559640746f0.png[/img]
Laser - Create laser beam that spans the level for 10 seconds
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue on Factory where clearing your calculation wouldn't actually clear the underlying value.
[*] UI cleanups & refinements
[/list]

I can see adding co-op to more modes like Exercises (and of course, online) but for now I'm letting it bake in classic mode. 

Thanks for playing!
ScienceRobot

notes.title: Build 0.6.0 Online Update!
notes.content:
Putting the finishing touches and testing the Online update. If all goes well I'm hoping to get this out sometime next week or early Nov.  Multiplayer is a simple P2P connection through Steamworks so a Steam connection is required and inviting someone else will be done through the Steam Friends menu.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/941d7135ef76a1f33d0f490549f7dc1fa1ba1fe9.jpg[/img]

After this update I'm looking to add some more variations to the standard classic mode and what the road to the 1.0 release looks like.  Expect some smaller updates here and there as I fix some bugs but the big changes will be saved for 1.0. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/980e09cb67496f003fd0a290f7606825c8830caa.gif[/img]

Thanks for playing!
ScienceRobot

notes.title: Build 0.5.1
notes.content:
Just a few QoL updates and behind the scenes cleanups, getting things in place for peer-to-peer PvP
- Numbers will appear and blink when respawning.
- Classic mode target number will now gradually increase as the rounds go on.  Instead of playing a game where you might get 20 - 110 - 10 as your numbers you'll get 10 - 20 - 110.
- Default max range for classic is 200 from 100.  If you already have a max set this won't affect you, just for fresh installs.

Thanks!

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
We have arrived on the Steam Store! Now what?

The first step is to get the demo ready before the next Steam Next Fest (Oct).  I plan on having this demo ready well before then and available to download.  I still need to nail down what I want to include in the demo so there may be several iterations of the demo leading up to the Next Fest but once that hits I'll be putting more focus on the first Early Access build.

In some ways, the Early Access build is ready and the demo will just be a subset of features from that but I want to turn focus onto building out the Store Page and getting a solid demo ready first, but rest assured, the Early Access build will come soon after the Next Fest barring any major setbacks like not actually being able to run the game on a potato.

Thanks for checking out Monkey Math, more updates to come.
-ScienceRobot
